    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Vue 实战：利用 IndexedDB 实现前端大文件断点续传</span>
    

</a>

        </h1>
        <div class="postbody">
            <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<h2><span class="ne-text">demo：&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/foxcharon/Vue2-Resumable-Upload-Demo-IndexedDB" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/foxcharon/Vue2-Resumable-Upload-Demo-IndexedDB</a></span></h2>
<h2 id="c1HZS"><span class="ne-text">一、背景与痛点</span></h2>
<p id="u100cdaa6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">前端下载大文件时，我们通常的做法是一行 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">fetch</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 拿到 response，转成 Blob，再丢给一个隐藏的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">&lt;a&gt;</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 标签触发下载。这套逻辑在几十 KB 的图片、几百 KB 的 PDF 上完全没问题。可一旦文件跑到 100MB、1GB，问题就来了：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="uf0830aa5" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">浏览器内存扛不住。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> fetch 把整个 response body 读到内存数组里，100MB 的文件就是 100MB+ 的堆内存占用，稍微大一点就直接 OOM。</span></li>
<li id="u6485ea8c" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">刷新归零。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 进度条跑到 80%，用户手滑刷新了页面——从头再来，已经下载的数据全丢了。</span></li>
<li id="u314c23b8" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">无法暂停恢复。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 浏览器原生没有"暂停下载"的概念，fetch 一旦发起，要么等到结束，要么 abort 掉全部作废。</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u349cf264" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这背后本质上是两个问题：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">流式数据怎么持久化</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，以及</span><strong><span class="ne-text">已持久化的数据怎么在下次请求时被服务器"认账"</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。第一个问题用 IndexedDB 解决，第二个问题靠 HTTP Range 请求。</span></p>
<p id="u51d557c1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">本文基于一个完整的 Vue 2 + Element UI 实战项目，把这两块串起来，讲清楚如何实现一个</span><strong><span class="ne-text">带持久化存储、支持断点续传、进度精确到小数点后两位</span></strong><span class="ne-text">的大文件下载方案。</span></p>
<h2 id="QRBQf"><span class="ne-text">二、核心原理：Range 请求与 206 响应</span></h2>
<p id="u19bc8518" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">HTTP 协议从 1.1 开始就定义了一个叫 </span><strong><span class="ne-text">Range</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 的请求头，语义很简单：告诉服务器"我只要这个文件的一部分"。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>Range: bytes=5000000-</code></pre>
<p id="uba222baa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">上面这行表示：从第 5,000,000 个字节开始，把后面的内容都给我。服务器如果支持分段传输，会返回 </span><strong><span class="ne-text">206 Partial Content</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，同时在 </span><strong><span class="ne-text">Content-Range</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 响应头里告诉客户端三件事：本次数据的起止位置，以及文件的完整大小。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>Content-Range: bytes 5000000-104857599/104857600</code></pre>
<p id="ue6add519" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">格式是 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">bytes 起始-结束/总大小</span></code><span class="ne-text">。这个 header 是整个断点续传的核心——客户端靠它知道文件有多大，以及自己还差多少。</span></p>
<p id="ucc0caf24" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果服务器不支持 Range（比如某些 CDN 或静态文件服务器没开这个能力），它会忽略 Range 头，照常返回 </span><strong><span class="ne-text">200</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 和完整文件。所以我们的代码需要兼容两种情况：206 就走续传逻辑，200 就清空旧数据从头来。</span></p>
<h2 id="zn2kU"><span class="ne-text">三、存储方案选型：为什么不用 LocalStorage</span></h2>
<p id="ud1243292" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">有人会想：浏览器不是有 LocalStorage 吗，5MB 够不够？答案是一票否决的——</span><strong><span class="ne-text">LocalStorage 只能存字符串，不能存二进制数据</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></p>
<table id="B0NlY" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u31b3f671" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">对比维度</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uee358e9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">LocalStorage</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u8459a5fd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">IndexedDB</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="ua419b16e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">容量上限</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uc2d193c6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">5-10MB</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uefc50da0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">浏览器可用磁盘的 50%-80%</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u8d7503e1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">数据类型</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u0c77d237" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">仅字符串</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u21822e04" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">String、Blob、ArrayBuffer、File</span></p>
</td>

</td>
<td width="250">

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">

</td>
<td width="250">

</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u18b6e872" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">支持索引、游标遍历</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p id="ude177228" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">对于大文件下载场景，核心要求有三个：</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u538a2c19" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">必须存二进制。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> fetch 流式读取出来的是 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Uint8Array</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 二进制块，LocalStorage 根本塞不进去。</span></li>
<li id="u2a243f1a" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">容量必须大。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 一个 100MB 的测试文件，存进去就是 100MB。LocalStorage 的 5MB 上限连塞牙缝都不够。</span></li>
<li id="u62e7b741" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">必须异步。</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 你不想每次写盘都卡 UI 渲染。</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u49a27cd6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">IndexedDB 是浏览器内置的</span><strong><span class="ne-text">事务型对象数据库</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，支持结构化克隆算法，</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ArrayBuffer</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 可以直接作为值存入，这些特性让它天然适合做文件分片的持久化。</span></p>
<h2 id="GpGP6"><span class="ne-text">四、实战代码拆解</span></h2>
<h3 id="lLac5"><span class="ne-text">4.1 项目架构简述</span></h3>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>src/
├── db/downloadDB.js              # IndexedDB 操作封装
├── store/index.js                # Vuex 状态管理
├── App.vue                       # 根实例：核心下载逻辑
└── components/DownloadChild.vue  # 下载按钮子组件</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u554fb207" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">DownloadChild</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 通过 Vuex </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">dispatch('requestDownload', { url, filename })</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 发起下载指令</span></li>
<li id="uf2ecd422" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">App.vue</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 通过 computed 属性监听 Vuex 中 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">downloadTask.timestamp</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 的变化，触发实际下载</span></li>
<li id="uc65d9e3e" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">downloadDB.js</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 封装所有 IndexedDB CRUD 操作，与业务逻辑解耦</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="Nr1Aj"><span class="ne-text">4.2 数据库设计</span></h3>
<p id="ucde545df" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">首先看数据库结构——一个 object store，一个索引，足以支撑整个断点续传：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>const DB_NAME = 'DownloadDB'
const STORE_NAME = 'chunks'

function openDB() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {
    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1)
    request.onupgradeneeded = (e) =&gt; {
      const db = e.target.result
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, {
          keyPath: 'id',
          autoIncrement: true
        })
        store.createIndex('filename', 'filename', { unique: false })
      }
    }
    request.onsuccess = (e) =&gt; resolve(e.target.result)
    request.onerror = (e) =&gt; reject(e.target.error)
  })
}</code></pre>
<p id="u0f32c169" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">每条记录包含五个字段：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">id</span></code><span class="ne-text">（自增主键）、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">filename</span></code><span class="ne-text">（用于索引查询）、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">chunkIndex</span></code><span class="ne-text">（分片序号，用于最终排序合并）、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">data</span></code><span class="ne-text">（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ArrayBuffer</span></code><span class="ne-text">，实际二进制数据）、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">size</span></code><span class="ne-text">（当前分片的字节数，用于进度累加）。</span></p>
<p id="uf9ef6904" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">选择 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">autoIncrement</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 主键而非 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">[filename, chunkIndex]</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 复合主键，是因为 IndexedDB 的复合主键在游标遍历时性能不如单字段索引，而我们的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">clearChunks</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 操作依赖游标删除，这是写入频率较高的路径。</span></p>
<h3 id="Y29xK"><span class="ne-text">4.3 核心下载流程：Range 请求 + 流式持久化</span></h3>
<p id="u12a9f103" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">整个 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">startDownload</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 方法是断点续传的核心，我按执行顺序拆成五个阶段来讲解。</span></p>
<p id="u0ef2c8a0" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">阶段一：查询已下载字节</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>let loadedSize = await getDownloadedSize(filename)</code></pre>
<p id="u170ac82c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里遍历 IndexedDB 中该文件的所有 chunk，累加 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">size</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 字段求和。即使之前页面刷新过、甚至浏览器重启过，只要 IndexedDB 中的数据还在，就能准确拿到已经下载了多少字节。</span></p>
<p id="u57dfd3ef" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">阶段二：构造 Range 请求</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>const headers = {}
if (loadedSize &gt; 0) {
  headers['Range'] = `bytes=${loadedSize}-`
}

const response = await fetch(url, {
  signal: this.abortController.signal,
  headers
})</code></pre>
<p id="u6aeda2b5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">loadedSize</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 为 0（首次下载或之前已清理），就不带 Range 头，服务器返回完整文件。如果大于 0，告诉服务器"从第 N 个字节开始给我"。</span></p>
<p id="u604722ec" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里同时传入 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">AbortController</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 的 signal，方便用户取消下载时中断 fetch。</span></p>
<p id="uba09b2fc" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">阶段三：处理 206 vs 200</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>let totalSize

if (response.status === 206) {
  const contentRange = response.headers.get('Content-Range')
  totalSize = parseInt(contentRange.split('/')[1])
} else if (response.status === 200) {
  if (loadedSize &gt; 0) {
    await clearChunks(filename)
    loadedSize = 0
  }
  totalSize = +response.headers.get('Content-Length')
} else if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`)
}</code></pre>
<p id="u3ae1bf79" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这是整个方法里最容易踩坑的分支逻辑：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u8d796382" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">206</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：服务器认了 Range，返回部分内容。我们从 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Content-Range: bytes 5000000-104857599/104857600</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 中取斜杠后面的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">104857600</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 作为文件总大小。</span><strong><span class="ne-text">注意不是 </span></strong><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Content-Length</span></code><span class="ne-text">——206 响应中的 Content-Length 只表示本次返回的 body 大小，不是完整文件大小。</span></li>
<li id="u2787bf4e" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">200</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：服务器不支持 Range。如果此时 IndexedDB 里还有旧数据，必须清空，因为之前存的 chunk 和现在返回的完整数据会产生重叠和错乱。</span></li>
<li id="u4edfe00a" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">其他非 2xx</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：直接抛异常，交给 catch 处理。</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u249ea31f" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">阶段四：流式读取并逐块写入 IndexedDB</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>const reader = response.body.getReader()
let chunkIndex = await getChunkCount(filename)

while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read()
  if (done) break

  await saveChunk(filename, chunkIndex++, value)
  loadedSize += value.length
  this.downloadPercent = parseFloat(
    ((loadedSize / totalSize) * 100).toFixed(2)
  )
}</code></pre>
<p id="ub9db236d" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">response.body.getReader()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 拿到的是 ReadableStream 的 reader，每次 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">read()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 返回一个 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">{ done, value }</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 对象，</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">value</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 是一个 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Uint8Array</span></code><span class="ne-text">，大约是几 KB 到几十 KB 不等的二进制块。</span></p>
<p id="u2e35c965" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">关键细节在 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">saveChunk</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 里：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>export async function saveChunk(filename, chunkIndex, data) {
  const db = await openDB()
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite')
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME)
    const buffer = new Uint8Array(data).buffer  // 拷贝一份
    store.add({ filename, chunkIndex, data: buffer, size: buffer.byteLength })
    tx.oncomplete = () =&gt; { db.close(); resolve() }
    tx.onerror = (e) =&gt; { db.close(); reject(e.target.error) }
  })
}</code></pre>
<p id="u08fdf537" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">new Uint8Array(data).buffer</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 这一步</span><strong><span class="ne-text">一定要做</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">reader.read()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 返回的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Uint8Array</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 可能共享一个更大的底层 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ArrayBuffer</span></code><span class="ne-text">，直接存入 IndexedDB 会导致数据不完整或错乱。做一个拷贝，虽然多花了一点内存，但保证了数据的正确性。</span></p>
<p id="ud446de6a" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">阶段五：合并分片，触发下载，清理</span></strong></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>async mergeAndSave(filename) {
  const chunks = await getAllChunks(filename)
  const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'application/octet-stream' })
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = url
  a.download = filename
  document.body.appendChild(a)
  a.click()
  document.body.removeChild(a)
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url)

  await clearChunks(filename)
}</code></pre>
<p id="u5a826893" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从 IndexedDB 按 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">chunkIndex</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 升序取出所有分片，每个分片还原成 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Uint8Array</span></code><span class="ne-text">，直接传给 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Blob</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 构造函数。</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Blob</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 可以接受 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Uint8Array[]</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 数组，会自动拼接。</span></p>
<p id="ue4030843" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">下载完成后务必调用 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">clearChunks</span></code><span class="ne-text">——既释放用户磁盘空间，也避免下次下载时 IndexedDB 里残留旧数据。清理逻辑使用游标遍历删除：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>export async function clearChunks(filename) {
  const db = await openDB()
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite')
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME)
    const index = store.index('filename')
    const cursorReq = index.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(filename))
    cursorReq.onsuccess = (e) =&gt; {
      const cursor = e.target.result
      if (cursor) {
        cursor.delete()
        cursor.continue()
      }
    }
    tx.oncomplete = () =&gt; { db.close(); resolve() }
    tx.onerror = (e) =&gt; { db.close(); reject(e.target.error) }
  })
}</code></pre>
<p id="u5ee9364c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里用游标而不是 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">index.getAll()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> + 逐条 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">store.delete()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 的原因有两个：一是游标一次只持有当前记录，内存友好；二是游标删除在一次事务内完成，要么全部成功要么全部回滚。</span></p>
<h3 id="F2eHh"><span class="ne-text">4.4 取消即保存</span></h3>
<p id="ua1cda97b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">注意代码中 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">startDownload</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 的 catch 分支：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>catch (err) {
  if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
    this.progressStatus = 'exception'
    return   // 不清理 IndexedDB
  }
  // ...
}</code></pre>
<p id="ue977a293" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">AbortError</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 代表用户主动取消——此时 IndexedDB 中的数据</span><strong><span class="ne-text">不会被清理</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。用户下次点击下载按钮，</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">getDownloadedSize</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 会读到之前累积的字节数，自动从断点继续。</span></p>
<h3 id="C38zy"><span class="ne-text">4.5 进度精度：为什么是 toFixed(2)</span></h3>
<p id="ub657a2d1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">进度计算公式本身很简单：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>this.downloadPercent = parseFloat(((loadedSize / totalSize) * 100).toFixed(2))</code></pre>
<p id="ud67188ea" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">toFixed(2)</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 把百分比控制到两位小数，这样 100MB 文件的最小分辨率约为 1MB × 0.01% ≈ 10KB。每次 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">reader.read()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 返回的 chunk 大约是几十 KB，进度条每隔几个 chunk 就会有一次肉眼可见的变化，不会出现"卡在 99% 不动"的体感。</span></p>
<p id="ucb6c0ed1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">配合 Element UI 的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">el-progress</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件，用 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">format</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 属性自定义显示文本：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-html highlighter-hljs" data-language="html"><code>&lt;el-progress
  :percentage="downloadPercent"
  :stroke-width="20"
  :text-inside="true"
  :format="percentFormat"
/&gt;</code></pre>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-javascript highlighter-hljs" data-language="javascript"><code>percentFormat(pct) {
  return pct.toFixed(2) + '%'
}</code></pre>
<p id="uc3a5a35c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这样进度条内部会显示 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">33.56%</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 这样的精确数值，而不是默认的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">34%</span></code><span class="ne-text">。</span></p>
<h2 id="ErRbd"><span class="ne-text">五、总结</span></h2>
<p id="uf5f3257a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这套方案本质上做了一件事：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">把浏览器的持久化存储能力和 HTTP 协议的分段传输能力结合起来，让大文件下载从"一次性内存操作"变成"可暂停、可恢复、状态可持久化的流式管道"</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></p>
<p id="u83d813af" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">实战中值得记住的几个点：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ue5e5e1ab" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">fetch + ReadableStream</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 是流式处理二进制数据的基础设施，</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">response.body.getReader()</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 是拿到这块能力的入口。</span></li>
<li id="u3d83ff9c" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">IndexedDB 是前端唯一能存大容量二进制数据的方案</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，但它基于事务，有并发限制，封装时要注意 Promise 化并确保每次操作后关闭连接。</span></li>
<li id="u955718bf" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">断点续传的关键在于对 206 和 200 的分支处理</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，尤其是"服务器不支持 Range 时要清空旧数据"这个逻辑，遗漏了就会导致文件损坏。</span></li>
<li id="u38faa906" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">进度条只是 UI 层面的反馈</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，真正的可靠性在于 IndexedDB 中的数据完整性——每一块 chunk 存入前做一次独立的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ArrayBuffer</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 拷贝，代价很小，收益是绝对的确定性。</span></li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
